name: Chores
title: Fishing, cook delivery and gravedigger bot for CKMud
description: Fishes (rests when fatigued, fights boss fish and rivals) and runs the royal cook delivery and the gravedigger excavation whenever their cooldown is up. Needs the MSDP package. Type `chores help`.
author: fried

aliases.name: chores
aliases.script:
if matches[2] == "update" then return CKMudUpdate("Chores") end
local function arg(s) if s and s ~= "" then return s end end
chores.command(arg(matches[2]), arg(matches[3]))
